additionalProperties.comment: Runs at IRAM 220071d0. r0=output queue, r1=position. Stores position at +0x13c and all 32 slots +0x34..+0xb0. Common reset reached from queue rebuild 220072ec, metadata clear 220072b4, and underrun recovery 22007280. Called around decoder repositioning in 220054c8 via those reset paths. Synthesized-audio history must be invalidated when these queue positions reset.
additionalProperties.name: Audio_ResetOutputQueuePositions_IRAM_220071b0

additionalProperties.comment: Fills an audio output buffer. When exposure counting is enabled, output route is headphones (0), and volume exceeds the configured threshold, accumulates rendered frames / sample rate as float seconds. At the configured limit (default 72000 seconds), clears the counter and invokes the registered callback.
additionalProperties.name: Audio_FillOutputBuffer
